title: Coconut and Hazelnut Macaroons
blurb: Chewy coconut biscuits studded with toasted hazelnuts, crisp on the outside and soft within.
steps: Heat your oven to 160°C and lightly spray a baking tray with cooking spray, or line it with baking paper.
Roughly chop the hazelnuts into halves and quarters, then toast them in a dry pan over medium heat for three to four minutes until fragrant.
Whisk the egg whites in a bowl until they hold soft peaks.
Gently fold in the sugar, then add the desiccated coconut, toasted hazelnuts and vanilla extract until combined.
Spoon twelve mounds of the mixture onto the prepared tray, spacing them apart.
Bake for 25 to 27 minutes until the macaroons are golden brown at the edges and firm to touch.
Leave them on the tray for five minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
